evidence.decision: After Roman Dmowski's 1923 Foreign Minister Activity is relinked to the existing Second Polish Republic identity, preserve polity UUID c6a9be73-8769-4b74-a066-c29555f508ba for Mieszko I's tenth-century early Piast polity and replace its misleading generic modern preferred names.
evidence.identity_rule: Early Piast State is a descriptive scholarly label for the tenth-century polity represented by Mieszko I's Activity, kept separate from the later Kingdom of Poland and from modern Polish republics; it is not asserted as a contemporaneous official state title.
